answer: Nobody is waved through free: 6 hours at the counter for every name, counted one by one is the price, and the voyage never covers it twice. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The hollow here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Brinewellbound salt gutter keeper brine writ is the proof, because a writ salt gutter keepers sign after gutter yard audits. Every spiral is counted once.
